bans.label: I-196 is a freeway, above the 35 mph low-speed vehicle cap in MCL 257.660(8)

unverified: Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

sources.label: MCL 257.657a (golf carts need a city resolution)

enforcement.note: Searched Holland's traffic code and the web for a golf cart resolution under MCL 257.657a. None was found, so plain golf carts stay off public streets. I-196 is banned. No other local low-speed vehicle ban list was found.
